page.overview:
Who is Nakaiwa?

Nakaiwa is a man who lived in the Wano Country 41 years ago.

Nakaiwa is a thin man of average height with a long head, a large chin, and droopy eyes. He wears a top with a tree pattern and a dark vest and scarf, as well as a woven hat.

Nakaiwa is fairly greedy and not very superstitious, being willing to kidnap a white boar for the Kurokoma Family's bounty. He was quite dedicated in this goal, spending an entire year searching for the animal with Oiwa and Koiwa. His greed is strong enough that he is even willing to kidnap bystanders to get paid, but despite the fact that he is secretly in love with the kidnapped woman, Nakaiwa is afraid of losing face in front of his comrades and makes no attempt to dissuade them from taking her hostage.

Nakaiwa was in love with Tsurujo, and frequented the tea house where she worked often. He planned to confess his love for her after receiving the reward money for finding a white boar. However, greed and fear of failing in front of his comrades did not stop him from taking her hostage.
